question: Should ClawHub/OpenClaw still support the legacy `https://molt.bot/install.sh` zsh installer, or should that path be redirected or retired in favor of current install commands?
rationale: The failing implementation is outside current main while current docs and UI point to maintained install flows, so automation cannot safely choose the product support boundary.

options.title: Redirect or retire the legacy installer
options.body: Point `molt.bot` users to the maintained OpenClaw/ClawHub install commands and document the supported Node range.

options.title: Support and harden the legacy installer
options.body: Bring the installer source under ownership, reproduce the macOS/Homebrew zsh failure, and guard unmatched cleanup globs.

options.title: Wait for fresh reproduction
options.body: Keep this waiting on author until there is evidence that a currently supported installer path still fails.

recommendation.title: Redirect or retire the legacy installer
recommendation.body: Point `molt.bot` users to the maintained OpenClaw/ClawHub install commands and document the supported Node range.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns the nearest current in-repo CLI/package install surface and release metadata trail.
